resources.title: RAG Evaluation Set Template
resources.description: A JSON starter for the 15-20 question hand-built evaluation set from Lesson 6 — question, expected_answer, expected_source, plus a scoring_results block for your recall@k and LLM-as-judge numbers before and after tuning. Pre-filled with three worked example rows showing the single-fact vs. multi-chunk question split.

resources.title: AI Project README Template
resources.description: The five-part README structure this course uses across Lessons 7, 12, 18, and 20 — problem, architecture, key design decisions, evaluation results, how to run it, known limitations — as a fillable template with sections called out for when safety/correctness decisions apply (Projects 2 and 3 specifically).

resources.chapterTitle: Project 3 — Tool-Using Agent With Human Approval
resources.title: Tool Risk-Tier & Approval Design Worksheet
resources.description: A CSV worksheet matching Lesson 14's risk-tier table — tool name, read-only vs. action, risk tier, requires_approval, reversible — pre-filled with the course's own look_up_order / issue_refund example so the classification pattern is clear before you add your own tools.

resources.title: SQL Safety Checklist for AI Data Analysts
resources.description: A checklist built from Lessons 9-10's connection and generation safety layers — parameterization, the read-only role, statement timeout, row limit, structured tool calls, and pre-execution validation — plus the honest known-gap callout about prompt injection via the user's question wording.

resources.title: Resume Bullet Rewrite Worksheet
resources.description: A fillable worksheet applying Lesson 19's action + artifact + framework pattern to all three of this course's capstone projects, with the lesson's own before/after example included for reference and a final checklist for catching vague claims or number mismatches against your README.
